output.summary: Large herbaceous perennial native to eastern North America, the Midwest and the South. It has red-to-purple stems and dark berries, but all parts can be toxic; only young shoots and leaves—not roots—are edible after repeated boiling, while mature leaves, stems and berries are poisonous.
output.edibilityNote: Young leaves and shoots are traditional Appalachian food only after repeated boiling; roots, mature leaves and stems, and berries are poisonous.
